items.title: A finitely presented closed subscheme of a relative Proj is cut out by finitely many forms
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a quasi-compact quasi-separated S, a quasi-coherent graded O_S-algebra A with p : X = Proj_S(A) -> S quasi-compact, and a closed subscheme i : Z -> X of finite presentation, there exist d > 0 and a quasi-coherent finite type submodule F of A_d with Z = Proj_S(A/FA) (source lines 8098-8108). The proof first writes Z as Proj(A/I) for a quasi-coherent graded ideal, then works over a finite affine open cover of S with finitely many homogeneous elements f_{i,j} covering each Proj(A_i), uses finite presentation of i to generate each local ideal by finitely many h_{i,j,k}, and picks a common degree d so that the sections h_{i,j,k} f_{i,j}^{(d - deg h)/deg f} all lie in one finite type F inside I_d.
